records.text: has anyone talked to Bright Partners yet?

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Bright Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for setting up Bright Partners on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Bright Partners* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, reached first_project on day 0 and sent 1 invite (early momentum), but key_milestone still unreached and no customer reply to onboarding email [email:ce793709]; internal note [slack:956678e6] suggests no contact yet. 8 days left, Starter, no tickets. Moderate-low odds unaided.

draft.subject: Next step for Bright Partners in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Nice work getting your first project set up in Wrenfield last week, and sending out an invite. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the first few tasks to that project is usually what makes the shared view click for a team.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through that first set of tasks with you -- just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
